Card.signature: Card(children: (Metric | BarChart | FunnelChart | LineChart | AreaChart | ComposedChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | Select | Button)[])
Card.description: Root container for an openui-lang block. Children stack vertically. Put titles, captions, and narrative in markdown outside the fence.

Metric.signature: Metric(label: string, value: string, detail?: string, tone?: "neutral" | "positive" | "negative")
Metric.description: Compact KPI or summary metric with an optional supporting detail and sentiment tone

Series.description: One named series of numeric values aligned to chart labels

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

FunnelChart.description: Conversion or pipeline funnel with stage labels and numeric values, typically decreasing from top to bottom

LineChart.description: Spectrum lines over ordered categories for trends and continuous data

AreaChart.description: Spectrum gradient area chart for trends

ComposedChart.description: Spectrum composed chart: first series uses bars, remaining series use lines

RadarChart.description: Spectrum radar chart for comparing nonnegative values across dimensions

PieChart.description: Spectrum pie or donut chart for nonnegative parts of a whole

RadialChart.description: Spectrum radial bars comparing nonnegative values on a shared scale

SelectItem.description: One option in a Select control

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], value: $binding<string>, placeholder?: string)
Select.description: Interactive selector bound to a $variable for switching the data shown in the UI

Button.description: Button that updates UI state, opens a safe URL, or continues the conversation

componentGroups.name: Metrics
notes: - Use Metric for a small set of decision-relevant KPIs, not as a substitute for prose.

componentGroups.name: Charts
notes: - LineChart or AreaChart for trends over time or ordered categories.
- ComposedChart draws the first series as bars and remaining series as lines on one shared scale.
- PieChart for parts of a whole; use the donut variant for a ring. RadialChart compares values on one shared scale.
- RadarChart compares nonnegative series across dimensions.
- BarChart for comparing values across categories.
- FunnelChart for stage conversion flows where each step is smaller than the previous.
- Define series with Series(category, values) references for line and bar charts.

componentGroups.name: Controls
notes: - Bind Select.value to a declared $variable and use that variable to change visible metrics or chart data.
- Use Button actions only for @Set, @Reset, @ToAssistant, or @OpenUrl; never invent unsupported tool calls.
